description: NF registration to NRF and related NRF/shared-data registration rules.

constraints.statement: The NF Service Consumer shall send a PUT request to the resource URI representing the NF Instance.
evidence: "The NF Service Consumer shall send a PUT request to the resource URI representing the NF Instance."
constraints.why_interesting: This is the core request method and target URI requirement for NF registration.

constraints.statement: The NF Instance ID used in the URI shall be globally unique inside the PLMN of the NRF where the NF is being registered.
evidence: "{nfInstanceID} represents an identifier, provided by the NF Service Consumer that shall be globally unique inside the PLMN of the NRF where the NF is being registered."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a testable uniqueness constraint on the identifier used for registration.

constraints.statement: The NF Instance ID format shall be a UUID version 4.
evidence: "The format of the NF Instance ID shall be a Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) version 4"
constraints.why_interesting: This constrains the accepted identifier syntax for the API.

constraints.statement: The PUT request content shall contain a representation of the NF Instance to be created.
evidence: "The content of the PUT request shall contain a representation of the NF Instance to be created."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required request body content rule.

constraints.statement: On successful NF Instance registration, the NRF shall return 201 Created.
evidence: "On success, \"201 Created\" shall be returned"
constraints.why_interesting: This is the required success status code for the operation.

constraints.statement: On successful NF Instance registration, the PUT response content shall contain the representation of the created resource.
evidence: "the content of the PUT response shall contain the representation of the created resource"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required response body rule that can be checked in an API test.

constraints.statement: On successful NF Instance registration, the Location header shall contain the URI of the created resource.
evidence: "the \"Location\" header shall contain the URI of the created resource."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required response header rule.

constraints.statement: If NF Instance registration fails due to errors in the encoding of the NFProfile JSON object, the NRF shall return 400 Bad Request.
evidence: "If the registration of the NF instance fails at the NRF due to errors in the encoding of the NFProfile JSON object, the NRF shall return \"400 Bad Request\" status code"
constraints.why_interesting: This defines a specific error mapping to a status code.

constraints.statement: If NF Instance registration fails due to unknown Shared Data IDs received in the NFProfile, the NRF shall return 400 Bad Request.
evidence: "If the registration of the NF instance fails at the NRF due to unknown Shared Data IDs received in the NFProfile, the NRF shall return \"400 Bad Request\" status code"
constraints.why_interesting: This defines another specific error mapping to a status code.

constraints.statement: If NF Instance registration fails due to NRF internal errors, the NRF shall return 500 Internal Server Error.
evidence: "If the registration of the NF instance fails at the NRF due to NRF internal errors, the NRF shall return \"500 Internal Server Error\" status code"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required server-error response for internal failures.

constraints.statement: In the case of redirection for NF Instance registration, the NRF shall return a 3xx status code.
evidence: "In the case of redirection, the NRF shall return 3xx status code"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required redirect status class.

constraints.statement: In the case of redirection for NF Instance registration, the NRF shall include a Location header pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance.
evidence: "which shall contain a Location header with an URI pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required redirect header behavior.

constraints.statement: The NRF shall allow registration of a Network Function instance with any NF type described in clause 6.1.6.3.3.
evidence: "The NRF shall allow the registration of a Network Function instance with any of the NF types described in clause 6.1.6.3.3"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a normative acceptance rule for supported NF types.

constraints.statement: The NRF shall allow registration of Network Function instances with custom NF types.
evidence: "it shall also allow registration of Network Function instances with custom NF types"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a normative acceptance rule for custom NF types.

constraints.statement: During registration of a Network Function instance with a custom NF type, any NF-specific data provided in the customInfo attribute shall be stored by the NRF as part of the NF profile.
evidence: "the NF instance may provide NF-specific data (in the \"customInfo\" attribute), that shall be stored by the NRF as part of the NF profile of the NF instance."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a testable persistence requirement for custom NF data.

constraints.statement: The NRF shall accept registration of NF Instances containing Vendor-Specific attributes.
evidence: "The NRF shall accept the registration of NF Instances containing Vendor-Specific attributes"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a normative acceptance rule for vendor-specific extensions.

constraints.statement: The NRF shall accept NF Profiles containing attributes whose type may be unknown to the NRF.
evidence: "therefore, it shall accept NF Profiles containing attributes whose type may be unknown to the NRF"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a testable compatibility requirement for unknown attribute types.

constraints.statement: Vendor-Specific attributes accepted in an NF Profile shall be stored as part of the NF's profile data in NRF.
evidence: "those attributes shall be stored as part of the NF's profile data in NRF."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a concrete persistence requirement for accepted attributes.

constraints.statement: If the NRF receives an NF registration with nfType set to NRF, it shall use the information contained in the nfProfile to target the registering NRF when forwarding or redirecting NF service discovery requests.
evidence: "if the NRF receives an NF registration with the nfType set to \"NRF\", the NRF shall use the information contained in the nfProfile to target the registering NRF when forwarding or redirecting NF service discovery request."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a state/routing rule affecting discovery forwarding behavior.

constraints.statement: If Shared-Data-Registration is supported, the NF Service Consumer shall send a PUT request to the resource URI representing the Shared Data.
evidence: "If the feature \"Shared-Data-Registration\" is supported, the NF Service Consumer shall send a PUT request to the resource URI representing the Shared Data."
constraints.why_interesting: This is the core request method and target URI requirement for shared-data registration.

constraints.statement: The sharedDataId used in the URI shall be globally unique inside the PLMN of the NRF where the NF is being registered.
evidence: "{sharedDataId} represents an identifier, provided by the NF Service Consumer that shall be globally unique inside the PLMN of the NRF where the NF is being registered."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a testable uniqueness constraint on shared-data identifiers.

constraints.statement: The sharedDataId format shall be a UUID version 4.
evidence: "The format of the sharedDataId shall be a Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) version 4"
constraints.why_interesting: This constrains the accepted identifier syntax for shared-data registration.

constraints.statement: The PUT request content for shared-data registration shall contain a representation of the SharedData to be created.
evidence: "The content of the PUT request shall contain a representation of the SharedData to be created."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required request body content rule for shared-data registration.

constraints.statement: On successful shared-data registration, the NRF shall return 201 Created.
evidence: "On success, \"201 Created\" shall be returned"
constraints.why_interesting: This is the required success status code for shared-data registration.

constraints.statement: On successful shared-data registration, the PUT response content shall contain the representation of the created resource.
evidence: "the content of the PUT response shall contain the representation of the created resource"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required response body rule for shared-data registration.

constraints.statement: On successful shared-data registration, the Location header shall contain the URI of the created resource.
evidence: "the \"Location\" header shall contain the URI of the created resource."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required response header rule for shared-data registration.

constraints.statement: If shared-data registration fails due to errors in the encoding of the SharedData JSON object, the NRF shall return 400 Bad Request.
evidence: "If the registration of the Shared Data fails at the NRF due to errors in the encoding of the SharedData JSON object, the NRF shall return \"400 Bad Request\" status code"
constraints.why_interesting: This defines a specific error mapping to a status code.

constraints.statement: If shared-data registration is not authorized with write access to the requesting NF, the NRF shall return 403 Forbidden.
evidence: "If the Shared Data is not authorized with write access to the requesting NF ... the NRF shall return \"403 Forbidden\" status code"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required authorization failure response.

constraints.statement: If shared-data registration fails due to NRF internal errors, the NRF shall return 500 Internal Server Error.
evidence: "If the registration of the Shared Data fails at the NRF due to NRF internal errors, the NRF shall return \"500 Internal Server Error\" status code"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required server-error response for internal failures.

constraints.statement: In the case of redirection for shared-data registration, the NRF shall return a 3xx status code.
evidence: "In the case of redirection, the NRF shall return 3xx status code"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required redirect status class.

constraints.statement: In the case of redirection for shared-data registration, the NRF shall include a Location header pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance.
evidence: "which shall contain a Location header with an URI pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required redirect header behavior.
